question: If x = 2y =3z and xyz =36 , what is the value of z?
explanation: 🔖\( x=2y=3z\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\therefore x=3z;y=\frac{3z}{2}\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}so, xyz=36\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 3z.\frac{3z}{2}.z=36\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 9{z}^{3}=72\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow {z}^{3}=8\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\therefore z=2 \)

question: Two numbers A and B are such that the sum of 5% A and 4% of B is two - third of the sum o f 6% A and 8% of B. what is the ratio of A and B.

\( \frac{5A}{100}+\frac{4B}{100}=\frac{2}{3}\times \left[\frac{6A}{100}+\frac{8B}{100}\right]\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 5A+4B=\frac{2}{3}\times \left[6A+8B\right]\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 3\times \left[5A+4B\right]=2\times \left[6A+8B\right]\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 15A+12B=12A+16B\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\Rightarrow 3a=4B\phantom{\rule{0ex}{0ex}}\therefore A:B=4:3 \)
